svg.aria-label: At Work: Data & AI engineering co-op: Microsoft Fabric lakehouses, Power BI semantic models and DAX, Dynamics 365 ingestion, and AI agents grounded on the prepared data. Leading: An EEG-to-robot project. An Emotiv EPOC X headset reads the wearer's mood, and a Temi robot says it out loud. Building: An AI judge and talent scout engine for Cozy Arena, the hackathon platform I built from scratch. It scores submissions on the code people actually wrote. Ask Me About: AI tooling, evaluating LLM output, robotics, and where UX and development meet.
